info.title: Aqarly API
info.description: Backend for the Aqarly platform's apps.

get.description: Whether the API is up and can reach its database.

The marketing site's listings: `getProperties()` in the frontend.
Each filter is optional and they combine.

Everything assigned to this technician. Open work is ordered started
first, then emergencies, then oldest; closed work, most recently closed
first.
One job. Refused (403) if this technician doesn't hold it.

post.description:
Arriving on site: moves the job to in-progress. Starting a job already
under way changes nothing.
Closes a started job. Needs at least two photos of the work.

'Can't do it': the job goes back to the office unassigned, with the
reason. It's no longer this technician's, so the request comes back
rather than a job.

get.description:
The queue: `getRequests`. Filters narrow together; oldest first unless
`sort=newest`.

post.description:
Raise a request, from ops, the housekeeping portal or a tenant:
`createRequest`.

get.description: One request with what it points at: `getRequestById`.
Who could take this request, best first: `getAssignmentCandidates`.

schema.title: Response Assignment Candidates Requests  Request Id  Candidates Get

post.description:
Give requests to one staff member: `assignRequests`. Closed work is
skipped.

schema.title: Response Assign Requests Requests Assign Post
Response Set Priority Requests Priority Post

post.description: Remove requests entirely: `deleteRequests`. Returns them as they were.

schema.title: Response Delete Requests Requests Delete Post

get.description: Units with one trade's counts and spend, busiest first: `getUnits`.

The buildings operations manages, by name: operations.ts's
`getProperties`. (Marketing listings are `/listings`.)
Cost and volume by building, most spend first: `getPropertyRollups`.

schema.title: Response Property Rollups Reports Properties Get

get.description:
Volume and spend by category, busiest first: `getCategoryRollups`,
without labels.

schema.title: Response Category Rollups Reports Categories Get

get.description: One trade's current staff with the load they hold: `getStaffRoster`.
One staff member, retired or not.

put.description: `updateStaff`. Leaving `photo` out keeps the one they have.

delete.description:
`removeStaff`: takes them off the roster once they hold no open work.
Their closed work still names them.

get.description:
The card, in its order: `getHousekeepingRates`. `includeRetired` adds
the services that have left it, so old bookings can still be named.

schema.title: Response List Rates Housekeeping Rates Get

post.description: `addHousekeepingRate`: goes at the end of the card.

delete.description:
`removeHousekeepingRate`: takes it off the card once no open booking
uses it. Bookings already made keep its name and their price.

get.description:
A tenant with the unit they occupy: `getTenantById`. The tenant
portal's notifications and history are built from `/requests?tenantId=`.

CandidateOut.title: CandidateOut
CandidateOut.description: A roster member ranked for one request's assign panel.

EnrichedRequestOut.title: EnrichedRequestOut
EnrichedRequestOut.description:
`EnrichedRequest` in the frontend's operations.ts: a request with the
records it points at. The frontend adds `tier` itself with `tierFor()`.

ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut
ErrorOut.description: Every refusal: a message the frontend can show as it is.

NewRequestIn.title: NewRequestIn
NewRequestIn.description:
`NewRequest` in operations.ts. `type`, `tenantId` and `charge` are not
asked for: the category decides the trade, the unit decides the tenant, and
the rate card decides the price.

PhotoIn.title: PhotoIn
PhotoIn.description: `PhotoInput` in types.ts: anything without bytes is dropped.

PropertyRollupOut.title: PropertyRollupOut
PropertyRollupOut.description: Cost and volume for one building, over the report period.

RateOut.title: RateOut
RateOut.description: `HousekeepingRate`, plus when it left the card, if it has.

RepeatFaultOut.title: RepeatFaultOut
RepeatFaultOut.description:
A unit that keeps failing the same way: the repair-versus-replace
signal. Derived when read, never stored.

RosterMemberOut.title: RosterMemberOut
RosterMemberOut.description: A staff member with their load, read off the requests they hold.

ServiceRequestOut.title: ServiceRequestOut
ServiceRequestOut.description:
`ServiceRequest` in types.ts. `stage` and `createdAt` are read from the
history (see the model); `schedule` and `handBack` are rebuilt from their
columns.

TenantAccountOut.title: TenantAccountOut
TenantAccountOut.description: A tenant with the unit they occupy.

UnitRecordOut.title: UnitRecordOut
UnitRecordOut.description: `UnitRecord`: a unit with what one trade's work there adds up to.

WorklistOut.title: WorklistOut
WorklistOut.description:
One technician's own work, split the way the screen draws it: the job
to lead with, the rest queued behind it, and what's closed.
